## 📋 Meeting Summary – SME Digital Transformation Project ↔ Discovery & Presales **Date:** 22 Sep 2026 **Duration:** 48 min | Participant | Role | |-------------|------| | **Ahmed Hassan** | Presales Solution Architect | | **Sarah Mitchell** | Client Product Manager | | **Michael Brown** | Client CTO | | **Omar Khaled** | Client Operations Manager | | **Emily Wilson** | Business Analyst | | **Daniel Clark** | Integrant Project Manager | | **Sarah** | (Customer) Operations Lead (informal) | | **Michael** | (Integration) Engineer | | **James** | Senior Developer (maintains current API) | | **** | (Compliance/Legal) Representative | | **** | (Security) Representative | | **** | (Finance) Representative | --- ### 1️⃣ Business Goal Create a **single, unified operations platform** for **BrightPath Logistics** that: * Gives any employee (based on role) a single pane‑of‑glass to view customers, orders, deliveries, support tickets, billing, and internal procedures. * Introduces a **read‑only AI assistant** (Phase 1) that can answer natural‑language queries, cite sources, and respect existing RBAC. * Supports a **hybrid deployment** (on‑prem + Azure) to satisfy compliance and data‑sovereignty constraints. --- ### 2️⃣ Core Functional Requirements | Area | Requirement | Notes | |------|-------------|-------| | **Unified UI** | Web‑app (responsive) that aggregates data from all source systems. | Phase 2: Teams‑bot integration. | | **Data Integration** | Real‑time (or near‑real‑time) read‑only access to:
• **FleetCore** (fleet & delivery)
• **CustomerDesk** (support)
• **BillingPro** (invoicing)
• **SharePoint** (documents)
• **OpsHub** (procedures) | Existing CSV/REST bridge will be replaced by an **event‑driven API layer** (Kafka/Service Bus). | | **AI Assistant** | • Answer natural‑language questions (e.g., “show delayed deliveries for Green Valley Foods last week”).
• Provide source citations (system + record ID).
• Read‑only – no write‑back.
• Contextual memory limited to the current session (configurable retention, e.g., 24 h). | Must honor Entra ID RBAC; fallback to “I don’t know” when data missing. | | **Security & Privacy** | • All data in‑flight encrypted (TLS 1.3).
• At‑rest encryption on‑prem & Azure (CMK).
• No PII/PCI sent to external LLM providers – use **retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG)** with on‑prem or Azure‑hosted embeddings.
• Mask/Pseudonymize sensitive fields in audit logs. | Compliance: GDPR, UK Data Protection Act, internal policy. | | **Audit & Governance** | • Log every AI request: user, timestamp, queried entities, systems accessed, and **masked** request/response.
• Immutable audit trail (write‑once storage).
• Ability to export logs for regulatory retention (7 yr). | | **Role‑Based Access** | Leverage **Microsoft Entra ID** groups → map to **policy engine** (OPA or Azure Policy) that filters data before it reaches the AI or UI. | | **Performance** | • Simple queries ≤ 5 s, complex reports ≤ 10‑15 s.
• UI shows progress spinner / “thinking…” indicator. | | **Scalability** | • 150 users (pilot) → 400 users (full roll‑out).
• Architecture must support horizontal scaling of API & AI services. | | **Operational Costs** | • AI token usage ≤ $80 k / yr (target).
• Cloud infra ≤ $30 k / yr (incl. Azure services, backup, monitoring). | | **Future‑Proofing** | • Design for **multiple AI agents** (Support, Ops, Reporting, Finance) without hard‑coding a single monolithic model.
• Plug‑in style “agent” framework (e.g., LangChain‑style orchestrator). | --- ### 3️⃣ Technical Decisions Discussed | Decision | Rationale | |----------|-----------| | **Hybrid Cloud** | FleetCore contains historic financial data that must stay on‑prem (compliance). Other workloads (AI, web UI, integration bus) can run in Azure. | | **AI Provider** | Still under evaluation – Azure OpenAI (GPT‑4o / Claude‑3.5), Anthropic, or self‑hosted open‑source model (e.g., Llama 3‑8B). Preference for **Azure OpenAI** because of native Entra integration, VNet isolation, and data‑exfiltration controls. | | **RAG Architecture** | To avoid sending raw PII to the LLM, we will **index** relevant data (customer records, tickets, procedures) into a **vector store** (Azure Cognitive Search or self‑hosted Milvus). The LLM only receives **retrieved snippets** (already filtered by RBAC). | | **API‑First** | All source systems will expose **REST/GraphQL** read‑only endpoints behind an API‑gateway (Azure API Management). Legacy CSV export will be phased out. | | **Authentication** | Single‑sign‑on via **Microsoft Entra ID**; tokens passed to backend services (OAuth 2.0 Bearer). | | **Authorization** | Central policy service (OPA) evaluates each request against the user’s Entra groups and the data classification (customer, finance, HR, etc.). | | **Logging** | Use **Azure Monitor + Log Analytics** for telemetry; **Azure Storage (immutable)** for audit logs. Sensitive fields are hashed/pseudonymized before write. | | **CI/CD** | Azure DevOps pipelines with gated PRs, automated security scans (SAST/DAST), and infrastructure‑as‑code (Bicep/Terraform). | | **Observability** | Distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry) across API gateway, integration services, and AI orchestrator. Alerts for latency > 5 s or error‑rate > 2 %. | --- ### 4️⃣ High‑Level Architecture (Phase 1) ``` +-------------------+ +-------------------+ +-------------------+ | Entra ID (SSO) |<-------->| API Gateway |<-------->| On‑Prem Systems | | (AuthZ) | | (Azure APIM) | | (FleetCore, | +-------------------+ +-------------------+ | CustomerDesk, | | | | BillingPro) | | | +-------------------+ | | v v +-------------------+ +-------------------+ +-------------------+ | Web Front‑End |<-------->| Integration Bus |<-------->| Azure Services | | (React/Next) | (REST) | (Service Bus) | (REST) | (Functions, | +-------------------+ +-------------------+ | Logic Apps) | | | +-------------------+ | | v v +-------------------+ +-------------------+ +-------------------+ | AI Orchestrator |<-------->| Vector Store |<-------->| Source DBs / | | (LangChain‑like| (RAG) | (Azure Search) | (filtered) | SharePoint) | +-------------------+ +-------------------+ +-------------------+ | v +-------------------+ | LLM (Azure Open| | AI / Anthropic)| +-------------------+ ``` * **Web Front‑End** – Authenticated via Entra ID, renders unified dashboard and AI chat UI. * **API Gateway** – Central entry point, enforces throttling, logging, and OPA policies. * **Integration Bus** – Event‑driven sync (Azure Service Bus) to keep on‑prem data refreshed in Azure (near‑real‑time). * **Vector Store** – Stores **embeddings** of searchable content (customer records, tickets, procedures). Access is filtered by RBAC before retrieval. * **AI Orchestrator** – Handles prompt construction, source citation, context window, and session memory. * **LLM** – Hosted in a **private VNet**; data‑exfiltration protection enabled. --- ### 5️⃣ Project Plan (Key Milestones) | Phase | Duration | Main Deliverables | |-------|----------|-------------------| | **Kick‑off & Discovery** | 1 wk | Detailed requirements, data‑model inventory, security‑review sign‑off. | | **Architecture & Proof‑of‑Concept** | 2 wks | POC of RAG pipeline (Azure Search + Azure OpenAI) with sample data; security validation (no PII leakage). | | **Core Platform Build** | 4 wks |
• API gateway & OPA policies
• Integration bus (on‑prem → Azure)
• Web UI MVP (dashboard + AI chat)
• Authentication/Authorization flow. | | **AI Assistant MVP** | 2 wks (overlaps with Core) | RAG‑based query handling, source citations, session memory (24 h), read‑only mode, audit logging. | | **Testing & QA** | 2 wks | Functional, security (penetration), performance (≤ 5 s), user‑acceptance testing (UAT) with 10 pilot users. | | **Pilot Deployment** | 2 wks | Deploy to Azure (staging VNet), onboard 150 users, collect usage & satisfaction metrics. | | **Pilot Review & Adjustments** | 1 wk | Refine RBAC rules, improve prompt templates, tune token usage. | | **Production Roll‑out** | 2 wks | Scale to 400 users, enable Azure AD Conditional Access policies, finalize audit‑log retention. | | **Post‑Go‑Live Support** | 4 wks | Hypercare, knowledge‑transfer, documentation hand‑off. | **Total Time to Production:** **~16 weeks (≈ 4 months)** – aligns with the client’s target. --- ### 6️⃣ Resource Allocation (Suggested Partner Team) | Role | Qty | Effort (weeks) | Comments | policies, integration bus. | | **Backend Engineers** | 2 | 6 | Data adapters for each source system, RAG pipeline. | | **Frontend Engineer** | 1 | 5 | React/Next UI, AI chat component, role‑based UI rendering. | | **AI/ML Engineer** | 1 | 5 | Prompt engineering, vector store schema, token‑cost optimisation. | | **DevOps Engineer** | 1 | 4 | IaC (Bicep/Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, monitoring set‑up. | | **Security Engineer** | 0.5 (part‑time) | 4 | Threat modeling, data‑masking, compliance sign‑off. | | **QA/Test Engineer** | 2 | 4 | Automated API tests, UI tests, performance testing. | | **Project Manager** | 1 | 8 | Sprint planning, stakeholder coordination, risk tracking. | | **Business Analyst (client‑side)** | 1 | 8 | Requirements grooming, UAT coordination. | *The client’s internal team (6 devs, 2 QA, 1 DevOps) will be **augmented** by the partner resources above, providing a **~30 % capacity boost** needed to meet the 4‑month timeline.* --- ### 7️⃣ Cost Estimate (High‑Level) | Category | Approx. Cost (USD) | Assumptions | |----------|-------------------|-------------| | **Professional Services** (design, development, QA, PM) | **$130 k – $170 k** | 5 months of mixed‑seniority staff (average $120 k / yr). | | **Azure Infrastructure (first year)** | **$20 k – $30 k** | API Management, Service Bus, Functions, Cognitive Search, Storage, VNet, backup. | | **AI Model Usage (tokens)** | **$30 k – $45 k** | 400 users × 20 Q/day × 2 k tokens avg × $0.000015 / token (Azure OpenAI GPT‑4o). Includes 10 % buffer for peak usage. | | **Licensing / SaaS** (Entra ID Premium, monitoring) | **$5 k – $8 k** | | | **Contingency (15 %)** | **$25 k – $35 k** | Covers scope changes, extra integration work, security audit fees. | | **Total (Year 1)** | **$210 k – $288 k** | Slightly above the stated budget; can be trimmed by:
• Selecting a smaller model (e.g., Azure OpenAI “gpt‑35‑turbo”) for the pilot.
• Reducing token‑budget (limit per user).
• Leveraging existing on‑prem compute for the vector store. | **Operating Budget (Year 2+)** – Expected to fall under **$80 k** if the model is switched to a lower‑cost tier after pilot and token caps are enforced. --- ### 8️⃣ Risks & Mitigations | # | Risk | Impact | Likelihood | Mitigation | |---|------|--------|------------|------------| | 1 | **Data leakage to external LLM** | Regulatory breach, reputational damage | Medium | Use **RAG** – only send filtered snippets; enforce VNet isolation; enable Azure OpenAI “no‑data‑logging” flag. | | 2 | **Hybrid sync latency** (on‑prem → Azure) | Stale data in UI/AI | Medium | Event‑driven CDC (Change Data Capture) + incremental sync every 5 min; fallback to on‑prem API for critical queries. | | 3 | **Hallucinations / inaccurate answers** | User mistrust, operational errors | High | Strict source‑citation requirement; fallback “I don’t know” when confidence < 80 %; post‑response validation layer. | | 4 | **Authorization bypass via AI** | Confidential data exposure | Medium | Enforce RBAC **before** data reaches vector store; OPA policies applied to each retrieval request. | | 5 | **Token‑cost overruns** | Budget breach | Medium | Implement per‑user token caps; monitor usage daily; auto‑scale down to cheaper model if thresholds exceeded. | | 6 | **Change‑management resistance** | Low adoption (< 70 % pilot target) | Medium | Early user‑training, embed AI suggestions in existing workflows, collect feedback loops. | | 7 | **Regulatory audit failures** (7‑yr retention) | Legal penalties | Low | Immutable audit log storage
